purpose: Compose translation mounts, center-to-center distance joints, slack center-distance limits, world-axis translation locks and slack world-axis translation limits around one shared donor-core integration step with bounded convergence-aware pre/post stabilization.

properties.options: bounded pre/post family passes, per-family iteration counts and convergence tolerances

limitations: distance-limit and axis-limit range interiors remain intentionally slack
axis locks and axis limits use world-space x/y axes and are not full prismatic/slider joints
fixed deterministic family order introduces ordering bias
conflicting constraints are bounded by pass counts and are not claimed to converge globally
no angular inertia, rotating local anchors, hinge, full slider/prismatic, rotational weld, motor or gear semantics
post-core projection can move bodies after donor-core contact evidence was generated

proves: the five-family contract shares exactly one donor-core integration step
bounded family pass and iteration budgets include axis limits
existing family semantics remain intact when axisLimits is empty
axis locks remain composed with guarded activity and component-isolation paths after the fifth family is appended
axis limits compose with bounded residuals, slack range semantics, guarded activity and component isolation without a second donor-core step

truth.basis: The composer names ordering bias, translation-only scope, slack-range semantics, contact-evidence timing and the non-prismatic nature of axis locks/limits.

agency.basis: Callers choose family data, bounded budgets, activity and convergence tolerances explicitly.

continuity.basis: Axis limits are appended after the existing four-family order while the donor source and prior family semantics remain preserved.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The integration reuses the bounded one-step composer rather than chaining standalone wrappers and accidentally integrating physics twice.
